data.title: The CLARITY Act Fails 50 to 49: What's Next for XRP, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana Now That Congress Is Done for the Year?
data.description: The Senate blocked the CLARITY Act 50 to 49. XRP fell 7.98%, while Bitcoin dropped by 1.42%. Here's what each coin retains without the bill.
data.author: Sam Daodu
